finding: Both visible demonstrations fit the same-polarity upper-right decoder; query 0 has a different protected-Racket answer. The original diagnostic subset guaranteed 00 and 22 bend tops but not off-diagonal tops.
limits: Six protected-Racket executions, one seed and one setting. Another upper-row-any-zero rival had a Python-only witness at seed 2; not claimed Racket-verified here.
program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((is-gap (lambda (c) (and (zero? (at g 0 c)) (zero? (at g 1 c)))))
                  (pieces-starts (filter (lambda (c)
                                           (and
                                             (not (is-gap c))
                                             (or (zero? c) (is-gap (- c 1)))))
                                         (range 0 w)))
                  (pieces-ends (filter (lambda (c)
                                         (and
                                           (not (is-gap c))
                                           (or (= c (- w 1)) (is-gap (+ c 1)))))
                                       (range 0 w)))
                  (pieces (map (lambda (i)
                                 (list (nth pieces-starts i) (nth pieces-ends i)))
                               (range 0 (length pieces-starts))))
                  (piece-type (lambda (p)
                                (let ((s (first p))
                                      (e (second p)))
                                  (if (= s e) 0 (if (zero? (at g 0 s)) 1 2)))))
                  (types (map piece-type pieces))
                  (trace (reduce (lambda (state t)
                                   (let ((cells (first state))
                                         (row (second state))
                                         (cur (third state)))
                                     (cond
                                       ((zero? t) (list (append cells
                                                       (list (list row cur)
                                                             (list (+ row 1) cur)))
                                               (+ row 2)
                                               cur))
                                       ((= t 1) (list (append cells
                                                       (list (list row (- cur 1))
                                                             (list row cur)))
                                               (+ row 1)
                                               (- cur 1)))
                                       (else (list (append cells
                                                           (list (list row cur)
                                                                 (list row (+ cur 1))))
                                                   (+ row 1)
                                                   (+ cur 1))))))
                                 (list (list) 1 3)
                                 types))
                  (all-cells (first trace)))
             (build-grid 8
                         7
                         (r c)
                         (cond
                           ((and (zero? r) (= c 3)) 3)
                           ((member? (list r c) all-cells) 2)
                           (else 0)))))))
